content:
clare: quick brain-dump 1: we should freeze a tiny SDK-visible routing header and move policy blobs to platform-only headers. This will cut churn in client libs and reduce console mapping surprises.

ivan: agree. propose names: x-rw-route (short kv), x-rw-meta (csv attrs), x-rw-route-ver (negotiation). platform-only: x-rw-policy (json blob).

mo: SDK action items: add parsing for x-rw-route + x-rw-meta, keep old blob parsing for two releases, and expose env RW_SDK_ENABLE_POLICY for Dedicated customers (off by default). Add unit tests.

clare: ops note 1: proxies can truncate long headers. If platform attaches x-rw-policy, ensure it's added inside the mesh or base64-encoded. We prefer platform enrichment so public headers stay small.

ivan: quota/console: we'll update ingestion to prefer x-rw-meta.cost_center then fall back to route parsing. That should avoid immediate breakage.

release-bot: scheduled canary deploy for header-shim next Friday 09:00 UTC.

clare: timeline: RFC this week, 2-week canary, 12-week deprecation for client-emitted policy blobs. I'll open RFC and link here.

mo: drafting SDK CHANGELOG snippets now.

ivan: I'll add monitoring to check percent of requests missing cost_center post-rollout.

clare: thanks all.
